verdict.rationale: Feitian sells OpenSK hardware that can run firmware built unmodified from Google's open-source OpenSK GitHub repository, so open firmware is available on that one product. The docs frame it as a way to 'experience and try' FIDO authentication. Nothing shows that the mainstream BioPass, MultiPass, or other production keys run open or audited firmware. Missing for 10: open-source firmware for the production key lines, any independent security audit of shipped firmware, independent or hands-on corroboration.
